title: USPS Mail Halved While Stamp Prices More Than Doubled
hook: Americans send far less mail, yet stamps cost more.
closing: Mail volume collapsed while the price of sending a letter climbed.
question: What do you still mail?

segments.say: USPS mail fell to 109 billion pieces, leaving the network with nearly half its peak traffic.
First-Class Mail fell to 46 billion pieces, showing letters led the collapse.
A stamp reached 68 cents, even as the mail stream kept shrinking.
